note: F1 qualifies today at Monza ahead of tomorrow's Italian Grand Prix.

front.title: New profile of John Ternus offers insight into life and reputation of Apple CEO
front.tldr: The Financial Times profiled John Ternus, who became Apple's chief executive this week after Tim Cook's departure, offering rare insight into how colleagues and partners see the company's new leader.

front.title: OpenAI releases major upgrade to ChatGPT and Codex with GPT-6 Astra
front.tldr: OpenAI has begun rolling out GPT-6 Astra, a major model upgrade, to Business and Pro subscribers on its $100 and $200 monthly plans, with wider access to follow.

front.title: Andrew Scott is 'powerfully moving' in Elsinore, playing Chariots of Fire star Ian Charleson's final Hamlet
front.tldr: Andrew Scott plays Ian Charleson, the Chariots of Fire actor who took on Hamlet at the National Theatre while dying of AIDS, in a Telluride premiere critics are calling deeply moving.

stories.title: The Pelican comparison grid for Astra is pretty interesting
stories.tldr: Developer Simon Willison tested OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra by generating SVGs of pelicans on bicycles at each reasoning level, a quirky but revealing way to compare model quality.

stories.title: Robot data startup XDOF in talks for $1.2bn Series B just three months out of stealth
stories.tldr: XDOF, a robot data startup, is raising a Series B at a $1.2 billion valuation only three months after leaving stealth, reflecting investor appetite for robotics data infrastructure.

stories.title: Google's Gemini Spark can now manage your Google Photos library
stories.tldr: Gemini Spark can now edit and curate photo albums, build shared collections and turn photos into calendar events for Google's AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

stories.title: AI compute provider Nscale seeks $3.5bn in pre-IPO financing
stories.tldr: Nscale, which struck a $45 billion deal with Anthropic, is in talks to raise fresh funding ahead of an expected IPO, a sign of how much capital AI infrastructure now demands.

stories.title: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy as CEO, replacing Shantanu Narayen
stories.tldr: Adobe has named Anil Chakravarthy as its next president and chief executive, succeeding Shantanu Narayen, who announced his departure earlier this year.

stories.title: Microsoft announces Project Zenith, a clutter-free Windows experience for developers
stories.tldr: Microsoft has unveiled Project Zenith, a stripped-down Windows interface aimed at developers, though it requires a powerful machine with 64GB of RAM to run.

stories.title: Nintendo announces two Direct livestream events for next week
stories.tldr: Nintendo will hold a Zelda-focused Direct on 8 September, followed by a broader one the next day, timed to overlap with Apple's own hardware event.

stories.title: CD sales are making an unexpected comeback amid a retro tech boom
stories.tldr: US CD revenue jumped 58.6% in the first half of 2026, reversing last year's decline as interest in retro tech and physical media keeps growing.

stories.title: iPhone Ultra, iPhone 18 Pro, and more: Apple's September 9 event preview
stories.tldr: Apple holds its September event on Wednesday, unveiling its 2026 iPhone lineup, including the long-rumoured foldable model alongside the standard slab-style phones.

stories.title: CarPlay now works with five major chatbot apps
stories.tldr: Anthropic's Claude has become the fifth major AI chatbot to add CarPlay support this week, letting drivers talk to it through their car's infotainment system.

stories.title: Apple planning AI home security camera and service for 2027
stories.tldr: Apple is designing a privacy-focused home security camera and service for 2027 that uses AI to monitor surroundings, according to a Bloomberg report.

stories.title: Leaked iPhone roadmap reveals plans for larger foldable and 'biggest overhaul' yet
stories.tldr: A Bloomberg report details Apple's roadmap through 2028, including a larger foldable iPhone, beyond next week's launch of this year's lineup.

stories.title: Danny Boyle's 'Ink' makes tabloid headlines at Telluride
stories.tldr: Danny Boyle brought Ink, his drama about Rupert Murdoch's launch of a British tabloid, to Telluride for its North American premiere after debuting at Venice.

stories.title: Tender Loving Care may be Mike Leigh's final film, and one of his best
stories.tldr: Kate O'Flynn stars in Mike Leigh's Telluride drama about two London social workers, a film reviewers say could be his last but ranks among his finest.

stories.title: A Long Winter: Andrew Haigh's moody Rockies drama is a sweeping act of storytelling
stories.tldr: Adapted from a Colm Toibin novella, Andrew Haigh's austere 1950s-set drama premiered at Telluride starring Fred Hechinger and Ebon Moss-Bachrach.

stories.title: Kenneth Branagh hosts Judi Dench, Anthony Hopkins, Ian McKellen, Gary Oldman and Helen Mirren in Telluride-bound doc 'Into the Breach'
stories.tldr: Judi Dench recalls how postwar stage stars such as Richard Burton and Anthony Hopkins were treated like rock stars, in Kenneth Branagh's documentary heading to Telluride.

stories.title: The Celtics offense could use a little more chaos this season
stories.tldr: A season preview argues Boston's offense, built on discipline and margins, could benefit from more improvisation and chaos to complement its structure.

stories.title: Carrick on Manchester United's transfer business and Zirkzee staying
stories.tldr: Head coach Michael Carrick discusses United's transfer window dealings and confirms that Joshua Zirkzee is staying at the club.

stories.title: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown sit down with Devin McCourty ahead of season opener
stories.tldr: Maye and Brown spoke with former Patriot Devin McCourty about their growing on-field relationship as New England prepares to open its title defence against Seattle.

stories.title: Pro Football Hall of Fame makes sweeping changes after Bill Belichick fiasco
stories.tldr: The Hall of Fame has overhauled its election process following the widely criticised handling of eight-time Super Bowl champion Bill Belichick's case.

stories.title: Patriots news: rebuilt roster, new fits, high expectations
stories.tldr: With week one approaching, expectations are rising for how well general manager Eliot Wolf and coach Mike Vrabel have rebuilt New England's roster for year two.

stories.title: Gasly loses Monaco GP podium as penalties reinstated after McLaren and Red Bull appeal
stories.tldr: The FIA's Court of Appeal reinstated Pierre Gasly's pitlane speeding penalties from Monaco, stripping him of his podium and shifting Alpine's championship standing.

stories.title: The early verdict on Ferrari's Italian GP engine upgrade
stories.tldr: Ferrari brought a second engine upgrade of the season to its home race at Monza, and drivers and engineers are giving their first assessment of its impact.

stories.title: Russell tops second practice as Mercedes respond to Ferrari at Monza
stories.tldr: George Russell beat Charles Leclerc to the fastest time in second practice at Monza, as Mercedes hit back after Ferrari's early pace on home soil.

stories.title: Gasper plays homer hero again to back Suarez's strong start
stories.tldr: Mickey Gasper homered again, extending his hot streak to eight home runs in 16 games, backing a strong outing from Ranger Suarez in Boston's win over Baltimore.

stories.title: Crochet throws off mound for first time since injury as Houck and Oviedo progress
stories.tldr: Garrett Crochet threw off a mound for the first time since his injury, while Tanner Houck and Oviedo continue progressing well toward a return.

finally.title: Go behind the scenes of Blackwing Pencils' ode to analog creativity
finally.tldr: A short film follows the multi-step process behind Blackwing pencils, made in factories in Japan and California, a quiet celebration of analog craft in a digital age.
